rounds.title: Kbd baseline
rounds.note: First drawing of the SDK kbd (et-kbd), drawn by its mock from @ethlete/components/design on the page: inline keycaps 3px apart, each at least 18px wide, 5px inline padding, a 1px --et-surface-border-solid edge, 4px radius, an 8% --et-surface-interaction-solid fill and 11px weight-500 text in --et-surface-color-muted-solid. States: single key (Esc), mod+k combo on Apple (⌘ K) and other (Ctrl K), keycaps inside a sentence and the story shortcut list on both platforms. Key text passes: 7.10:1 on the keycap fill light, 6.16:1 dark (7.81 / 6.94 against the page). Q98, numbers only: the keycap fill is 1.10:1 against the page light, 1.13:1 dark; the edge is 1.26:1 against the page light, 1.73:1 dark (1.15 / 1.53 against the fill). The kbd is not interactive, so 1.4.11 does not require 3:1 for the cap; the text carries it. No decided rule applies: the kbd has no focus ring (Q88) and no mint (Q99), so no variant b and no Q102. Variant a alone shows today.

a.note: Today, alone in this round: no decided rule applies (no focus ring, no mint). Key text 7.10:1 on the fill light, 6.16:1 dark. Q98 open: fill 1.10:1 / 1.13:1 and edge 1.26:1 / 1.73:1 against the page, light / dark.
